answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a burn registry. To join, an agent burns 500 POA into a public registry and receives one non-transferable credential tied to its keypair. Peers audit the ledger every epoch: recycled burns and duplicate keypairs are rejected, and a cheater's credential is revoked on the spot. Forging 10,000 fake identities burns 5,000,000 POA — gone forever — plus 10,000 distinct keypairs and 90 days of audit queues. Like water carving karst, slow honest work shapes solid rock, while an umber stain of fraud shows at the inlet before it can spread. - Jowy
